companyContext: Danish family-owned company founded in 1932 in Billund, Denmark, that designs, manufactures and sells construction toys based on its iconic interlocking plastic brick system, alongside themed sets, minifigures, video games, films and LEGOLAND parks.
brandContext: LEGO is the master brand for the construction toy system, minifigures and themed product lines. The 'LEGO Editions' sub-theme launched in 2026 to celebrate the FIFA World Cup with the first-ever official LEGO minifigures of football legends Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé and Vinícius Júnior, available in 'Football Highlights' letter-shaped diorama sets and larger 'Football Legend' display sets.
productName: LEGO Editions – Football Legends (Légende du foot): Messi, Ronaldo, Mbappé & Vini Jr.

typography.fontUses: Official LEGO wordmark / logo lockup only (proprietary in-house typeface, not for body copy)
Headlines and campaign hero titles such as 'Légende du foot'

brandVision: Inspire and develop the builders of tomorrow by letting fans of every age build, play and celebrate their passions — bringing the magic of football to life brick by brick so that 'everyone wants a piece of the game'.
brandValues: Imagination, creativity, fun, learning, caring and quality. The Football Legends activation extends these values into sport: celebrating skill, dedication, diversity (Argentina, Portugal, France, Brazil), teamwork and the joy of play shared between kids, families and global icons.
